description:
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Front Turn Light Assembly for the Passenger Side.
Features the change from Amber Running Light Lens to Clear Running Light Lens to give a Fog Light Effect.
Suzuki OEM
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Front Turn Light Assembly – Passenger
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
